name: Unframed Stream
essence: A variable-length shipment is stored as transport chunks instead of complete records.

examples.summary: A variable-length shipment is stored as transport chunks instead of complete records.
examples.mechanism: An asynchronous byte reader yields fixed four-byte chunks, and the consumer treats each read as a complete record despite accepting unrestricted record lengths.

ingredients.suggests: The async consumer mistakes each transport read for an application record.
Arbitrary record lengths are concatenated without lengths or separators.

examples.summary: Variable-length names are concatenated without framing, then each fixed-size asynchronous read is stored as a record..

ingredients.suggests: The asynchronous consumer treats each transport chunk as a complete record.

ingredients.suggests: The pipe consumer treats each partial read as a complete record.
